ventures.name: QCVerse
ventures.affiliation: Independent product, not affiliated with THIQAH
ventures.summary: An AI-powered Quality Engineering and Test Automation product that helps QA engineers move from requirements to test cases, automation scripts and bug reports with AI-assisted workflows.
ventures.team: Built collaboratively by the QCVerse Team.
capabilities: AI test case generation from user stories
Requirement analysis (acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies)
Automation script generation for Playwright, Robot Framework and Selenium
notes: Capabilities are as described on the public website; available tools depend on account permissions and connected services.
Showcase figures on the QCVerse website come from one illustrative sample run; AI-generated test cases are drafts that require human review.
